_readme: Companies whose career boards ats-search queries. Add one object per company: name, ats (greenhouse | lever | ashby | workable | recruitee) and board (the slug in the company's board URL, e.g. boards.greenhouse.io/<board>, jobs.lever.co/<board>, jobs.ashbyhq.com/<board>, apply.workable.com/<board>, <board>.recruitee.com). Keep 'checked' current when you re-verify a board.
